method: We read every German string again: the start (Folge and gist item); the LS1 Reisebedingungen with their items, pool, reserve and micro-output; the LS2 dialogue (14 lines and their say overrides) with its items, pool, reserve, micro-output and Aussprache; the LS3 rule table, pool, reserve and cloze; the LS4 texts t1-t5, the tb2.sb1 and tb2.hv3 blocks and the strategy cards; the LS5 task (Planungsblatt, persona, hint words, model turns); the LS6 task (ad, booking confirmation, Leitpunkte, checklist, model text); the endLines; and the check items, proofs, Rückschau, Porträt, Redemittel, story and facts. We solved all 91 authored items blind from promptDe plus options, tiles or audio line, compared each result with answer and accepted[], permuted every sentence-building item by hand, and recorded every key position. We checked the exam blocks and Aufgaben against content/course-v2/registries/lanes/tb2.json (sb1, hv3, sa, m3), including the word counts with the validator's own wordCount. Grammar was checked against grammar-spine.json and b2.1/rule-cards.json, lexis against level-profiles.json (b2.1) and b2.1/specs.json, the can-dos against registries/cando/b2.json, the voices against casts/b2.json and casts/series.json, and the plan against docs/course-v2/curriculum/b2-1.md E4. We traced the player and runtime paths the r1 fixes depend on: ItemView.jsx (option order), content.js dictationItems, SpeakingTaskView.jsx, and speakingAI.mjs normalizeSpeakingTask / buildCoursePartnerPrompt. We re-verified each of the 18 r1 findings. For the three r1 class rules, we rebuilt the r1 defects in a scratch copy outside the repo (26 keys back at options[0]; ls1-p08 without the Mittelfeld order) and ran the validator on it: OK. The facts were checked from knowledge of the BGB text and vzbv; there was no network in this session. Validator on the unit: OK, 34 pass, 0 fail, 1 warn (LEX-02 ratchet 67), 4 skipped at unit scope; check.mjs: 0 errors.
verdict: Not exitable in round 2: 0 BLOCKER, 1 MAJOR, 8 MINOR. On the unit side the round was very successful. 16 of the 18 r1 findings are fixed in the unit, including the blocker (keys now 8/9/9) and all four unit-side majors: a case-based q04, the new ls1-p08 order, an Ersatz-free t2 with its own voice, and a demand-only q06.
